mapper.select: SELECT u.id, c.id AS company_id, c.name AS company_name, u.name, t.id AS type_id, t.name AS type_name, u.code, p.id AS parent_id, p.name AS parent_name, COALESCE(ec.employee_count, 0) AS employee_count, NULL AS null_col FROM units u LEFT JOIN companies c ON u.company_id = c.id LEFT JOIN unit_types t ON u.type_id = t.id LEFT JOIN units p ON u.parent_id = p.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT e.unit_id, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM employees e GROUP BY e.unit_id ) ec ON ec.unit_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{id}

SELECT u.id, c.id AS company_id, c.name AS company_name, u.name, t.id AS type_id, t.name AS type_name, u.code, p.id AS parent_id, p.name AS parent_name, COALESCE(ec.employee_count, 0) AS employee_count, NULL AS null_col FROM units u LEFT JOIN companies c ON u.company_id = c.id LEFT JOIN unit_types t ON u.type_id = t.id LEFT JOIN units p ON u.parent_id = p.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT e.unit_id, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM employees e GROUP BY e.unit_id ) ec ON ec.unit_id = u.id WHERE NOT u.type_id = 1 ORDER BY u.id

SELECT u.id, c.id AS company_id, c.name AS company_name, u.name, t.id AS type_id, t.name AS type_name, u.code, p.id AS parent_id, p.name AS parent_name, COALESCE(ec.employee_count, 0) AS employee_count, NULL AS null_col FROM units u LEFT JOIN companies c ON u.company_id = c.id LEFT JOIN unit_types t ON u.type_id = t.id LEFT JOIN units p ON u.parent_id = p.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT e.unit_id, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM employees e GROUP BY e.unit_id ) ec ON ec.unit_id = u.id ORDER BY u.id

SELECT u.id, c.id AS company_id, c.name AS company_name, u.name, t.id AS type_id, t.name AS type_name, u.code, p.id AS parent_id, p.name AS parent_name, COALESCE(ec.employee_count, 0) AS employee_count, NULL AS null_col FROM units child LEFT JOIN units u ON u.id = child.parent_id LEFT JOIN companies c ON u.company_id = c.id LEFT JOIN unit_types t ON u.type_id = t.id LEFT JOIN units p ON u.parent_id = p.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT e.unit_id, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM employees e GROUP BY e.unit_id ) ec ON ec.unit_id = u.id WHERE child.id = #{id} AND child.parent_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT u.id, c.id AS company_id, c.name AS company_name, u.name, t.id AS type_id, t.name AS type_name, u.code, p.id AS parent_id, p.name AS parent_name, COALESCE(ec.employee_count, 0) AS employee_count, NULL AS null_col FROM units u LEFT JOIN companies c ON u.company_id = c.id LEFT JOIN unit_types t ON u.type_id = t.id LEFT JOIN units p ON u.parent_id = p.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT e.unit_id, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM employees e GROUP BY e.unit_id ) ec ON ec.unit_id = u.id WHERE u.parent_id = #{id} ORDER BY u.id

SELECT e.id, c.id AS company_id, c.name AS company_name, u.id AS unit_id, u.name AS unit_name, p.id AS position_id, p.name AS position_name, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.email, e.phone, e.dob, NULL AS null_col FROM employees e LEFT JOIN units u ON u.id = e.unit_id LEFT JOIN positions p ON p.id = e.position_id LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.id = u.company_id WHERE e.unit_id = #{id} ORDER BY e.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO units (company_id, name, type_id, code, parent_id, leader_id) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{name}, #{typeId}, #{code}, #{parentId}, #{leaderId})
mapper.update: UPDATE units SET company_id = #{companyId}, name = #{name}, type_id = #{typeId}, code = #{code}, parent_id = #{parentId}, leader_id = #{leaderId} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT u.id, c.id AS company_id, c.name AS company_name, u.name, t.id AS type_id, t.name AS type_name, u.code, p.id AS parent_id, p.name AS parent_name, COALESCE(ec.employee_count, 0) AS employee_count, NULL AS null_col FROM units u LEFT JOIN companies c ON u.company_id = c.id LEFT JOIN unit_types t ON u.type_id = t.id LEFT JOIN units p ON u.parent_id = p.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT e.unit_id, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM employees e GROUP BY e.unit_id ) ec ON ec.unit_id = u.id WHERE LOWER(u.name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')) OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')) OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')) OR LOWER(u.code) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')) ORDER BY u.id
